title: The public page of a business type (job CM, blueprint sections 7 and 13)
description: packages/packs/<id>/landing.json: the words and blocks of the PUBLIC marketing page of one business type (its own page, e.g. /construction). It sits NEXT TO pack.json and is not part of it: pack.json is synced into the database as an immutable, versioned manifest (a change there is a new version and a migration), while the public page is website copy that changes without touching any workspace. The page also reads the pack's own names, summary, accent, owl prop and owl-team labels from pack.json, so nothing is said twice. A pack without a landing.json has no public page. Every text is {en, te, hi, kn}: English is required, the other languages fall back to English per text (a test flags a missing one). {brand} in a text is replaced by the product name. A text never holds a price, a percentage, a rating or a customer count (the site's honesty tests refuse them). The only code the page needs per business type is a BLOCK from the closed list below (calculator, fee_preview, children_promise): a block is present when its key is present, so a new business type that needs no new block is data only.

pack.description: The folder name and the pack id this page describes.

slug.description: The public address: /<slug> (English) and /te/<slug>, /hi/<slug>, /kn/<slug>. Not the pack id: the address is for people.

home_card.description: The plain card of this business type on the home page ("Currently built for"): who it is for, what it does in one line, and the words of the link to its page (a type with a calculator names it in the link). Optional: without it the card shows the pack name and its hero eyebrow.

steps.description: This business type's own words for any of the six steps of the home page and /how-it-works (job CZ), keyed "1" to "6": a step it does not list uses the shared words. A school, for example, does not look for students on the web, so its steps 1 and 2 read "Admission enquiries captured" and "Know who's asking". Optional; the helper names come from the pack's agent.* labels.

plan_fit.description: One line each for the pricing page: what kind of business of this type each plan fits.

calculator.description: BLOCK: the public quantity calculator (packages/quote-engine/ts/construction.ts, the same code as the app). Figures are typical, not a seller's.

pieces_per_area_x1000.description: Pieces per square foot, in thousandths (4.5 = 4500).

fee_preview.description: BLOCK: a WhatsApp conversation mock of a reminder, labelled as an example. A message from the business is `school`, from the other person `parent` (the names are the mock's two sides).

children_promise.description: BLOCK: the promise about children's data (ADR 0084 part 5). It states rules the tools are built to follow, and says what is not live yet.
